question: Which of the following was proposed by the British Government with regards to structuring the Indian Government in 1909?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Morley-Minto Reforms.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian Council Act of 1909 is also called as **Morley- Minto Reform.**
 
• **It was instituted to pacify the Moderates (Congress) and introduce separate electorates on the basis of religion**.
 
• So, Lord Minto came to be famous as the **Father of Communal Electorate in India.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/414582af6439c774a7e2e41faf21e22eed329664dcfa859fb2514aac0fd90d68.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Wavell Plan **was first presented at the Shimla Conference in **1945.****​**
 
• Rowlatt's acts authorized** definite political cases to be tried without juries and permitted the internment of suspects without trial**.
 
• **The Cripps Mission** was a failed attempt in **late March 1942** by the British government to save full Indian cooperation and support for their efforts in World War II.
